conviction_note: Both the FY8/26 actuals and the FY8/27 headline guide (revenue about ¥10.0bn, OP about ¥1.3bn) were pre-released on 2026-09-30 and bought +8.2% on 10-01, so the print mostly refines numbers that are already public. What is left is a capital-return announcement, which is plausible because of last year's buyback and an activist adding stake, but has no source, set against a crowded margin long and a name that has sold 5 of its last 8 prints. The findings net to 0; the scaled number is -0.17 (p_up 48 × abs 4.2).
bar: Company's own pre-released numbers, 2026-09-30 修正 notice: FY8/26 revenue ¥5,811m / OP ¥846m / ordinary ¥880m / net ¥481m / dividend ¥10; FY8/27 revenue about ¥10.0bn, OP about ¥1.3bn, 'to be published in refined form on 2026-10-07' (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260930/140120260917537637.pdf). No 四季報/IFIS FY8/27 number could be sourced, so the company pre-release is the bar and every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register 2.93% of shares (2 sellers) as of 2026-09-29, up 0.09pt from 2.84%: shorts slightly building and not crowded (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html via baseline). 信用倍率 6.47 (baseline; kabutan shows 6.47 on 2026-10-07), so leveraged retail is crowded long. findings.finding: The print's main content was pre-released on 2026-09-30: FY8/26 OP ¥846m (above the ¥760m plan) on revenue of ¥5,811m (below the ¥8,014m plan), the ¥177m Gosan Tech impairment, a ¥10 dividend held, and FY8/27 at about ¥10.0bn revenue / about ¥1.3bn OP. The stock repriced +8.16% on 10-01 and holds there (773 on 10-06, 762 at seal), with 信用倍率 6.47. This name fell the next session after 5 of its last 8 prints, including -9.6% after the last full-year print even though that print carried a ¥500m buyback, so a refinement of a guide that is already public leans to 材料出尽くし.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Next-session closes after past releases, from Yahoo daily bars: 2025-10-10 -9.61% (FY print: FY26 guide -60% OP, mid-term plan withdrawn, ¥500m buyback); 2025-04-11 -14.23% (guide cut); 2025-01-14 +18.16%; 2026-01-14 +5.74%; 2026-04-09 -2.24%; 2026-07-13 -6.97%; 2025-07-14 -3.73%; 2024-10-16 +2.27%. The pre-release itself: 2026-10-01 +8.16%.
findings.why_not_priced: Most of it IS priced: the +8.16% day on 10-01 shows the headline guide was absorbed, which is why this is sized small. The unpriced part is only how 'about ¥1.3bn' is refined. The company's record is mixed (FY8/25 initial OP guide later cut from ¥2.07bn to ¥1.90bn; FY8/26 revenue missed the plan by 27%). A crowded margin long (6.47) has to sell a release that adds nothing.
findings.independence: The reaction history comes from Yahoo bars (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/6255.T?range=2y&interval=1d) and the margin ratio from kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6255), both separate from the 9/30 notice. The margin ratio and the run-up are also in the baseline lean, so that part counts once.

findings.finding: Shareholder-return setup: at the last full-year print (2025-10-09) NPC announced a ¥500m / 3.56% buyback in the same TDnet batch and completed it by 2025-12-16. Hong Kong fund LIM Advisors, which first filed a 5% holding on 2025-10-17, raised its stake to 7.00% on 2026-09-28, nine days before this print. The dividend has been ¥10 for three years while the pre-released FY8/27 OP implies EPS of roughly ¥40+. A repeat buyback or a dividend increase with this release is plausible, but no document says it will come.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The one comparable: the 2025-10-09 buyback came with a -60% OP guide and the stock fell 9.61% the next session, so the buyback did not offset the guide. There is no clean read on a dividend increase (¥2 to ¥6 to ¥10 over FY22-FY24).
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing has been pre-released on returns. The 9/30 notice covers only the FY8/26 dividend. If the market were already paying for a buyback, the stock would have kept rising after 10-01; instead it went 769, 750, 758, 773, 762. Capacity is the counterweight, and it is why this is sized small: cash fell ¥2.1bn through Q3 as work-in-progress grew by ¥3.0bn (Q3 短信), and the ¥10 dividend was held explicitly as 'per the original plan'.
findings.independence: The LIM Advisors 変更報告書 6.00%→7.00% is a separate EDINET filing (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6255&b=n202609300786, 2026-09-30). The buyback completion notice: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251217/140120251217521397.pdf

outside_window.finding: The domestic large project whose acceptance slipped past 2026-08-31 is due to book in FY8/27 H1, and First Solar's South Carolina line relocation is driving the modification and relocation work. Both resolve over the coming quarters, not at this print.

baseline_tension: Priced lean is +0.29 (a short-squeeze term against margin overhang and the run-up), and my findings net to zero against it. The strongest positive the release could carry is a buyback or dividend increase, prompted by LIM Advisors building to 7% and last year's ¥500m buyback; I looked for it and found no pre-announcement. The negative rests on a pre-released guide meeting a crowded margin long, not on a visible miss.
lessons_applied: Open question 4 (a pre-print run-in sized as a short was wrong once) and rule 2 (negatives over-represented): sell-the-news finding cut from -1.0 to -0.6, p_up 45 to 48.
Open question 3 (a pre-released print moved +0.13%): abs_move_pct cut from 4.5 to 4.2, close to the proxy, even though this name's own median next-day move is about 6.4%.
Rule 2's demand to look for the strongest positive was already met by finding 2 (capital return), which is left at +0.6.
